label: Willing an actual GOOD_4 of a recipient to it suffices for non-passional q.20 LOVE_1
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, OPEN one-way interpretive bridge, attribution deferred (ST I q.20 a.2: to love is to will good to someone). For all g, x and respects r: if x is good in r and g wills that good to x, then g loves x in the thin non-passional sense. It adds no friendship, affection, equal degree, approval of wrongdoing or perfect relational love.
